create_responses: create an OpenAI-compatible responses handler that processes /v1/responses requests with streaming, background, and store support
retrieve_responses: retrieve a previously stored response by its response_id from the in-memory response store
cancel_responses: cancel a queued or in_progress background response by its response_id and abort the associated task
responses_stream_generator: stream a response as a sequence of OpenAI responses protocol events including text deltas and tool call events
responses_full_generator: collect a complete non-streaming responses output and return a ResponsesResponse with usage information
